integrity: The conservation law is proved by combining the published Gauss--Bonnet identity, inner-parallel curvature Riccati equation, and surface-area variation, then differentiating exactly. Volume loss follows by integrating the area profile. The bundled checker is only a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: Specific to three-dimensional lambda-lenses and their inner parallel bodies before extinction; it does not extend the reverse-isoperimetric inequality to new dimensions or to arbitrary polyhedra, and an unindexed classical formulation of the same first integral remains a residual originality risk.
title: A conserved edge defect integrates inner-parallel \(\lambda\)-lenses in three-dimensional space forms
